description: Plan item 6: move every right-dock test fixture from Layers to ONE shared Snaps helper without weakening assertions, and add explicit tests for Layers position (1280x720, 1366x768 capped 100/125/150%, 1600x1000; after Reset; after save/reload), Layers title visible without scrolling, no right dock by default, rail outer/inner width, icon-scaling rule with no overflow at min and max rail, max rail keeps canvas minimum, plus the computed layout table that justifies LEFT_RAIL_MAX 460 and a mutation (RED) proof.
